comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus reposition a crept rail to restore expansion gaps.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine rotary tool use and response-based tuning versus high-load linear repositioning and gap setting.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable safe stops plus lock retention versus 10 mm at both rail joints. The record supplies no specs or tolerances.
comparison.reason: Although both involve adjustment, one tests dynamic energy absorption and a retained collar; the other tests static rail geometry.
